user.title: Inim SmartLiving Alarm Setup
user.description: Search the network for SmartLAN boards, or choose how the panel is connected to enter its details. The search only finds boards on the same subnet as Home Assistant.

discover.title: Boards found
discover.description: Boards found on Home Assistant's subnet that are not set up yet: {count}. Choose one; its address is filled in on the next page.

discover_none.title: No new boards found
discover_none.description: No SmartLAN board that is not set up yet answered. The search only reaches boards on the same subnet as Home Assistant: enter a board on another subnet or VLAN by hand. The search also needs the UDP ports 5001 and 7001 free on the Home Assistant host.

smartlan_si.title: SmartLAN/SI connection
smartlan_si.description: Enter the connection details of the SmartLAN/SI board and a user PIN of the panel.

data_description.port: 5004 unless it was changed in the board's settings.
data_description.pin: A user code of the panel (1 to 6 digits). Commands are sent with it, so it needs the areas you want to control.

smartlan_g.title: SmartLAN/G connection (experimental)
smartlan_g.description: Enter the connection details of the SmartLAN/G board and a user PIN of the panel. SmartLAN/G support has not been tested on a real board yet: please report how it works.

data_description.port: The port set in the board's settings (the installer software proposes 5004).
data_description.username: The user name of the board's web page; together with the password it encrypts the connection.
data_description.password: The password of the board's web page.
data_description.pin: A user code of the panel (1 to 6 digits). Commands are sent with it, so it needs the areas you want to control.

items.title: Areas, zones, scenarios and outputs

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: The zones of the panel: only terminals programmed as zones are listed.

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.description: The outputs your user code may switch: terminal outputs and the fixed outputs O1-O3. Only the outputs the installer marked as home automation outputs are ticked for you: an output can drive a siren, a lock or a gate, so tick only the ones you mean to switch from Home Assistant. An output on one of the panel's first three terminal positions cannot be switched remotely and is not listed.

initial_options.title: Initial Options
initial_options.description: Set the initial options for your Inim Alarm integration. These can be changed later from the integration's configuration page.

data.event_log_size: Number of Events to store in log

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Inim SmartLiving Alarm
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details of {panel_name}. The panel is contacted with the new details and its configuration (names, zones, scenarios) is read again. Entities and options are kept.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.pin: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.

area_switches.title: Area switches arm mode per area
area_switches.description: The mode each area's switch arms in when it is turned on. *Use the default* follows **Area switches default arm mode** in the general settings. The arming mode select of each area and the `arm_area` action are not affected.

general.title: General settings
general.description:
Adjust the settings for your Inim Alarm integration.

Commands are sent with the user code **{user_code}**, which controls these areas: {user_areas}.

data.event_log_size: Number of Events to store in log

data_description.pin: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.
data_description.area_switches_default_arm_mode: Mode used when an area switch is turned on, unless its area has its own mode under Area switches arm mode per area. The arming mode select of each area sets any mode.
data_description.zones_not_ready: Before arming areas or activating a scenario, the panel is asked which zones are not ready. Refuse: nothing is sent and an error lists the zones. Arm anyway: the command is sent and a notification lists the zones, which can trigger an alarm. Either way the inim_smartliving_alarm_zones_not_ready event lists them.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to the panel at {host}:{port}. The panel configuration was not changed.

notification_system_report_message.message: The file you just downloaded is encrypted: attach it to your GitHub issue. Download diagnostics once more within 10 minutes to get a readable copy of the same report, to check what you are sharing. Keep that copy private: it contains names, the serial number and addresses (Full), or also PINs, phone numbers and passwords (Full confidential). Delete it when you no longer need it. The level goes back to Redacted afterwards.

refuses_arming_not_ready.name: Refuses arming with zones not ready

alarm_reset.name: Alarm Reset
alarm_reset.description: Resets every area of the Inim panel that has an alarm or tamper memory.

reread_panel_configuration.name: Re-read panel configuration
reread_panel_configuration.description: Reads the configuration of the Inim panel again (names, zone setup, scenarios) and reloads the integration. Options are kept.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: The Inim SmartLiving panel whose configuration is read again.

arm_area.name: Arm area
arm_area.description: Arms or disarms one or more areas of an Inim panel in a single command. Before arming, the panel is asked which zones are not ready; then the integration's "When zones are not ready" option applies: the command is refused, or sent with a warning.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: The areas imported from the panel, listed by their names. In YAML, the area numbers as on the panel.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How to arm the areas, or disarm them.

force.name: Arm anyway
force.description: Arm even if zones are not ready, with a warning. The panel can still refuse, if it is set not to allow arming with zones not ready.

activate_scenario.name: Activate scenario
activate_scenario.description: Activates one scenario of an Inim panel. The panel is asked first which zones are not ready for it; then the integration's "When zones are not ready" option applies: the scenario is refused, or activated with a warning.

scenario.name: Scenario
scenario.description: The scenarios imported from the panel, listed by their names. In YAML, the scenario number as on the panel.

force.name: Activate anyway
force.description: Activate even if zones are not ready, with a warning. The panel can still refuse, if it is set not to allow arming with zones not ready.

unsupported_panel.title: {title}: panel not supported
unsupported_panel.description: {title} is a panel this integration has no memory layout for yet ({panel}). It keeps running as before, read with the SmartLiving 1050's layout, so names, zones, scenarios and the event log may be wrong. A new setup of such a panel is refused. Please report it on GitHub with the model and firmware.
